messages:
elaine: Heads-up — planning session for Q3 security roadmap. Need to lock down retention + key backend decisions before product OKR planning. Can we sync requirements for hosted vs private customers?
marco: +1. Current proposal: default audit retention 90 days for hosted, 365 for Dedicated/Private by contract. HSM-backed keys only for Private initially.
ryan: Cost callout: 365 days of audit logs increases storage ~4x for some customers. We should offer tiered retention (90/180/365) as opt-in.
sasha: From product POV customers keep asking for per-route retention (e.g., embeddings vs logs). We need a launch-min scope — do we support per-route at GA or later?
marco: I'd push per-customer retention config at GA, but per-route is v1.1. Per-route adds complexity to purge jobs + indexing.
legal: SOC2 ask: retain audit logs for at least 12 months for evidence; but customers may require longer for compliance. We need legal-hold capability before purge.
elaine: Ok — launch criteria checklist idea: (1) Default retention policy implemented, (2) Legal-hold flag + manual restore, (3) KMS integration for hosted + HSM option for Private, (4) Audit log tamper-evidence (hash chain), (5) Docs + data processing addendum updated. Agree?
marco: That seems reasonable. Implementation notes: we'll emit per-event SHA256 and write a daily manifest with cumulative hash to S3 + write metadata to KMS-encrypted store. That gives tamper-evidence. Example manifest snippet:
```
{
  "date": "2026-07-01",
  "events": 123456,
  "root_hash": "3f2a..."
}
```
ryan: For KMS vs HSM: hosted -> cloud KMS (Google/AWS) w/ CMEK. Private -> offer HSM (PKCS#11) integration. We should call out SLAs: HSM key changes require 72h rotation window and ops runbook.
security-bot: Reminder: there is an open JIRA SEC-1942 for retention purge orchestration. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-1942
sasha: Product tradeoffs to capture for roadmap doc: - Time to implement (est. 3 sprints for default retention + purge) - Ops burden (managing HSM rotations) - Billing model for extended retention - UX for legal-hold & export
elaine: Prioritization proposal: Q3-1: default retention + purge + legal-hold + audit manifests. Q3-2: KMS integrations + hosted CMEK. Q4: per-route retention, retention tiering UI, HSM GA for Private.
marco: Dev notes: implement purge workers as idempotent, ensure they obey legal-hold and retention metadata. Add KV flag in tenant metadata: `retention_exempt:true` for holds.
legal: Also confirm deletion proof for customers — we should produce deletion receipts (signed manifest) when purge runs so customer can prove we deleted data.
ryan: Ops will need a retention-cost dashboard in Console to show projected monthly storage by retention tier. Add as an acceptance criterion.
elaine: Action items: @marco draft technical spec this week, @sasha add prioritization + PR FAQ, @legal draft retention clause and legal-hold wording, @ryan stub Console ticket for retention dashboard. We'll review at Fri roadmap sync.
marco: Noted. I'll include a migration plan for existing logs and a fallback to cold storage for >365 days.
sasha: Will add customer examples (finance startup needs 7 years) so sales can surface exceptions early.
elaine: Great — thanks all. If anyone has objections to the prioritization ping here before EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
